title: Share page: a lookup field shows its raw stored record id to an anonymous visitor — render a neutral placeholder instead (no target-record disclosure)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Ruling on #27200 (on-hold batch #2, letter C): 「其他同意」 to triage's recommendation C, 2026-11-08. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

外部访客打开分享链接 `/s/TOKEN` 时，查找字段显示一串内部记录 ID（如 `0a7f…`），看起来像系统坏了。改为显示中性占位（例如「已关联记录」），不显示 ID，也不读取被关联记录。只改界面，不碰安全边界。

## What is wrong

- `GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve` answers a lookup as its stored id, with `fields[key].reference` and `displayField`. It reads no second record, by design (#26991, PR #27107; `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts`).
- The share page renders that id as the field value, so the visitor sees an opaque id.

## Expected

- On the share page, a lookup (and master-detail) field with a value renders a neutral, localized placeholder, for example 「已关联记录」 / "Linked record". An empty value renders as empty, as today. The stored id is never shown.
- No change to the resolve answer, and no read of the target record. Showing the target's name (option B on #27200) is a security-boundary question kept on #27200 as its restart condition.
- Pins: a share page with a filled lookup shows the placeholder and no id; CONTROL: a non-lookup field renders as today.

Related: #27200 (source, stays `pm:on-hold` for option B), #26991, PR #27107, PR #27199.
